method: AI-assisted official HTML and fee-PDF text reading. Web screenshot results exposed text placeholders only; direct public PDF downloads returned non-PDF responses and could not be rendered. No visual PDF verification, portal session, independent human review or application submission is claimed.

microMasters.applied: Second term, subject to approved full-certificate application

hkust.decision: Ordinary fees mode-specific; common category rounds need no invented applicant selector. No universal two-year experience rule or automatically deducted transfer discount.

nus.normalAcademicPath: Honours OR four-year bachelor/equivalent, quantitative science/engineering/computing; FAQ exceptions for other fields and strong academic grades without normal degree length

english.validity: Two years from test; unexpired at application, not a today-based countdown
english.waiverScope: Main page AND vs FAQ and/or; entirely English-medium postgraduate evidence subject to confirmation

cases.label: International student - standard fee case
cases.note: International standard 10-course programme total, not the eligible NUS-alumni concession. Funding payable by the student/sponsor is not calculated.

cases.label: International NUS alumnus - eligible, not scholarship/sponsored
cases.note: International NUS-alumni total after the documented 20% rebate, only if eligible and not on scholarship/sponsorship. No additional rebate is stacked.

cases.label: Singapore citizen / PR - eligible, not scholarship/sponsored
cases.note: Singapore citizen/PR total after the documented 40% rebate and cohort-only SGD 5,450 study award; not a general or future-cohort price. Scholarship/sponsored local cases require a separate university quote.

extraCourseSgd.note: Level-5000 list; level-4000 and DSA5201 may differ; extra-course rebates not assumed

fees.miscellaneous: Compulsory per semester, amount not captured

nus.documents: Identity/pass as applicable, official transcript/grading/GPA evidence, degree or student status, CV, applicable English report, financial statement or approved scholarship/sponsorship/loan. GRE/referees not required; statement/internship evidence optional.
nus.decision: Regular-cycle-only stored dates avoid claiming a continuous early-to-regular opening. Three documented eligible fee cases per mode; no fallback price for funded local/unknown cases. FAQ alternatives, waiver ambiguity, financial evidence and PDF verification remain manual.
